docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:9:This law defines Source Atlas as always-running source authority for PLOS execution. It does not implement source freshness, change existing Source Atlas models, alter R2 distribution, add pack payloads, or rename existing types. If this law conflicts with active truth files, the truth files win and this law must be repaired before any dependent issue closes Green.
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:13:Source Atlas is operational architecture, not a static content library.
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:15:During PLOS runtime work, Source Atlas must continuously answer:
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:26:Source Atlas can provide reusable source, claim, requirement, proof, projection, path, and starter guidance. It must not become a store of finished exact-user plans, a generic content shelf, or a hidden source of unreviewed authority.
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:44:  - freshness manifest, pack hash/signature, changed claim IDs, rollback pointers, and local update receipt concepts

docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:62:Source Atlas authority covers these responsibilities:
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:66:| Source truth | Claims that affect runtime behavior must bind to source records, local proof, or an explicit source-needed state. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:75:| Share eligibility | Sharing requires public-safe source authority and privacy-safe projection; user-private context is not shareable by default. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:87:| local-proof-only | Locally verified by user proof or local receipt, without public source authority. | Can shape local execution when safe; not official source truth or share authority. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:94:| contradicted | Claims conflict with current source, another source, or local proof. | Blocked until resolved. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:96:| blocked | Risk, review, safety, privacy, or policy blocks runtime action. | Not eligible. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:109:| Affects another goal | cross-goal consequence, source conflict, proof or schedule collision | This path has consequences elsewhere in the user's life system. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:118:Every source, claim, pack, seed, path overlay, proof map, or share projection that can affect runtime behavior needs an applicability envelope:
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:149:If any of those checks fail, PLOS must use source-needed, needs-review, starter-guidance-only, local-proof-only, jurisdiction-needed, high-risk guarded, or blocked behavior as appropriate. It must not call the result source-backed Green.
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:165:Any future PLOS issue that claims Source Atlas authority, source-backed pathing, source freshness, pack eligibility, seed availability, sharing eligibility, or official-current behavior must reference this law before Green.
